# New Bulk Business Search Endpoint Now Available in SBC Connect API

_Category: API Meetings · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Apt766525** (7/10/2025):

On the July 10th 2025 the Registry Search API has been updated with a new bulk business search endpoint.

The Registry Search has provided a new search experience into the business registry of the Province of BC. This API offers a real-time, secure, direct connection between your systems and the Registry Search service now with support for bulk queries.

**Whatâ€™s New:**

The new bulk business search endpoint enables users to search using multiple business identifiers and/or names in a single API request, significantly improving efficiency for systems that need to validate or retrieve multiple business records at once.
